cohort: The study included 176 pregnancies in 170 women (mean age 32 years, 56% primigravida) with various heritable thoracic aortic diseases, such as Marfan syndrome and Loeys-Dietz syndrome, enrolled in a global registry.
finding: The aortic dissection rate in pregnant women with HTAD under specialized surveillance was lower than previously reported, though pregnancy was associated with aortic growth and dissections, warranting close monitoring, and breastfeeding was linked to a significantly lower occurrence of major adverse cardiac events (MACE).
